headlines.desc: Klay Thompson blew out part of a shoe while defending a fast break in the Heat's game against the Thunder on Sunday night.

headlines.title: Alexander-Walker has 27 points as Hawks roll to 107-97 win over Pistons in off game for Cunningham
headlines.desc: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 27 points, Atlanta opened the fourth quarter with an 18-0 run, and the Hawks beat the Detroit Pistons 107-97 on Sunday as Cade Cunningham was held to a season-low five points.

headlines.title: Murray's putback with 5 seconds left lifts Kings to 97-96 win over Celtics, ending 8-game skid
